title: Katherine Mansfield's birth chart
metaDescription: Katherine Mansfield's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.1° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Mercury and Venus sit 0.8° from an exact conjunction — near enough that the tradition reads thinking and taste as a single working part. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 21.1° Libra. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — a air sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 15.4° Scorpio, Venus at 16.1° Scorpio, Mars at 23.1° Sagittarius. Mercury in a water sign reads as a mind that absorbs before it argues; Venus in a water sign reads as taste tuned to mood and undertow; Mars in a fire sign reads as drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Jupiter opposition Pluto, 0.3° of separation. The scheme reads an opposition as an axis to walk, not a fight to win: the chart keeps both ends lit. Behind it, Saturn sextile Uranus at 0.5°, and Mercury conjunction Venus at 0.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Four planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Libra at 21.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 16.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 5.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Leo at 18.3° is in detriment. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 air, 3 fire, 2 water by element and 4 fixed, 4 mutable, 2 cardinal by mode. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aquarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.1° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 13.3°.
